items.title: Fortinet Sinks 12% in a Week as the Cybersecurity Selloff Spreads: Is It Time to Load Up?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysFortinet stock fell 12% in the past week, adding to its post-earnings slide as Palo Alto Networks, CrowdStrike and Zscaler sold off alongside it. Service revenue grew just 13% in the third quarter while billings grew 29%, and management says big deals are taking longer to activate.
